title: SMP Recognized with Two Top Supplier Awards
summary: The release of MEMA’s 2027 Top Suppliers directory features an entirely new recognition program for aftermarket suppliers going above and beyond in key areas. ...
body_markdown:
The release of MEMA’s 2027 Top Suppliers directory features an entirely new recognition program for aftermarket suppliers going above and beyond in key areas. These distinctions celebrate companies that are making a meaningful impact on our industry and highlight the suppliers leading the aftermarket forward.


SMP stands alone as the only supplier recognized with two Top Supplier Awards: Industry Engagement and Sustainability.


SMP is dedicated to being engaged in key industry initiatives, including advocacy and training. Several SMP employees serve on industry committees and boards, participating in industry advocacy, research, business and trade support and more. Over 3,000 SMP employees have sent letters to elected officials in support of Right to Repair legislation, protecting vehicle owners’ right to choose where and how their vehicle is repaired and that independent repair shops have access to the same diagnostic data, repair procedures, and tools as dealerships. In addition, SMP’s training department trains 40,000 professional technicians each year, ensuring they are equipped with the capabilities and expertise to diagnose and repair the vehicles of today and tomorrow.


SMP is also committed to finding better ways to advance our sustainability goals for our business and the communities we serve. This includes providing a portfolio of products that keep existing vehicles operating safely and efficiently, and bettering our operations through efficiency gains, emissions and water reductions, and waste minimization.


These distinctions are a testament to the collaboration and dedication of employees across multiple departments. From industry advocacy and training to sustainability improvements, these awards are made possible by the collective efforts of our people and a shared commitment to moving SMP and the aftermarket forward.
